# assistassets-ai

Last-checked: 2026-07-03

Canonical organization: https://github.com/assistassets-ai

assistassets-ai hosts local-first software for finance-oriented analysis and evidence review. Public projects should be described as exploratory software or workflow support, not as financial, tax, legal, accounting, or investment advice.

Public repository count checked against GitHub on 2026-07-03: 2 (`FinancialProof` and `.github`). Private or internal repositories are intentionally omitted from this public index.

## Public repositories

- https://github.com/assistassets-ai/FinancialProof
  - Local-first Streamlit tool for historical financial market pattern analysis, technical indicators, scenario exploration, sentiment analysis, SQLite-backed state, and evidence-oriented review.
  - Topics and search phrases: local-first financial analysis, Streamlit finance tool, market data exploration, technical indicators, ARIMA, Monte Carlo, sentiment analysis, SQLite state, market evidence review, no trading advice, no financial advice.

- https://github.com/assistassets-ai/.github
  - Organization profile, community files, and machine-readable context for assistassets-ai.
  - The visible GitHub organization profile is `profile/README.md`.

Private or internal repositories are intentionally omitted from this public index.

## Risk boundary

assistassets-ai projects are not financial advisers, not trading systems, not tax advisers, not legal advisers, and not substitutes for professional review. Treat generated output as exploratory analysis or workflow context only.
